ops.text: Shared-worktree coordination hazard: a verification lane ran `git checkout -- holder/runtime.go` to revert its own temporary debug instrumentation in a linked worktree that MULTIPLE lanes were editing uncommitted — wiping another lane's in-flight fixes along with the debug lines. Recovered this time (reconstructed from the island baseline + fixes captured verbatim in the lane's own reads, then byte-verified by the file's original author), but the near-miss is structural: `git checkout -- <path>` / `git restore` / `git stash` on a shared multi-agent worktree is destructive to every uncommitted change on that path, not just the caller's. Guidance for multi-lane worktrees: revert debug edits by targeted Edit (remove exactly the lines you added), never a whole-file git checkout; if a whole-file revert is unavoidable, snapshot the file first and diff-restore only your own hunks. Seen 2026-08-03, fusekit v0.21 flag day, holder/runtime.go.
